front.title: CATS C-SMA Service-Metrics Snapshots and C-SMA-to-C-PS Transport Bindings

abstract.t:
This document defines a service-metrics snapshot published by a CATS Service Metric Agent (C-SMA) to a CATS Path Selector (C-PS). The snapshot conveys service-metric records and their observation window, together with publication context supporting versioning and the FULL, INVALIDATE, and WITHDRAW operations.
The document defines the snapshot contract and two transport modes for the C-SMA-to-C-PS interface: Centralized Mode, using YANG-modeled operational state delivered by gNMI, and Distribution Mode, proposing a BGP-LS service-metadata mapping. The BGP-LS mapping is illustrative until its wire encoding and code points are specified.
